title: OLEANDER Digital Product / HCD Design Process v0.1 — Candidate
purpose: Develop human-centred digital products from scope/research authority through context of use, user needs/use requirements, interaction/content/state design, evaluation/usability/accessibility, detailed implementation handoff, implemented-product readback and live continuous improvement without treating UI completion as HCD evidence.
scope_in: interactive digital product and service experience
user research, context of use and use-related requirements
conceptual model, information architecture, navigation and task interaction
digital accessibility and inclusive interaction design within appointed scope
implemented-product HCD readback and live continuous improvement
scope_out: software architecture and production code quality
privacy/legal approval and data governance outside appointed HCD scope
content factual authority outside content-design responsibility
operational service truth not actually evidenced
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, organisational/legal/accessibility/security authority and responsible HCD/product practitioners. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Digital Product / HCD until explicit promotion.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires human-centred digital research/design/evaluation or a digital interaction is relied upon for user outcomes.
design_question_types: context of use and user research
experience architecture, conceptual model, IA and navigation
live research, analytics and continuous improvement
responsibility_triggers: digital interaction shared variable consumed by engineering/content/service
analytics/instrumentation used to support product decisions
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid ceiling across context-of-use evidence, user-needs/use-requirement evidence, design artifacts, research/evaluation, accessibility, content, privacy/security handoff, implementation/runtime readback and live/analytics evidence governs.
not_triggered_when: visual mockup is presentation-only with no material interaction/usability claim
static exhibition page has no material user task or service claim
UI screenshot is a communication artifact and does not claim HCD evidence
mandatory_reopen_triggers: engineering implementation diverges from evaluated design

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential HCD/user-research evidence, accessibility requirements, content authority, privacy/security/legal inputs, product/runtime evidence and live analytics must be admitted through task/claim Operational Mount before supporting a professional HCD decision.
required_methods: current human-centred design methods appropriate to the project and claim
implemented-product and live outcome readback when claimed
source_routes: ISO 9241-115 current user-system interaction design guidance
W3C WCAG 2.2 when web accessibility applies
evidence_routes: research plans, consent/data-handling records and participant/session evidence
standard_code_routes: WCAG 2.2 or applicable accessibility standard when triggered
jurisdiction- or product-specific digital requirements where applicable
precedent_case_routes: bounded digital-product precedents only where user/context/platform/operational applicability is established
practice_routes: current OLEANDER digital/HCD practice and failure evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current web/app/prototyping/accessibility/analytics execution knowledge when tools are used

remaining item is later/outside current claim
owner and reopen trigger are explicit
no controlling-authority conflict contradicts current claim
integration_readback_requirements: change propagation after material user/design/implementation/live evidence changes

native_source_of_truth_rules: editable/source research/design/prototype/specification artifacts remain authoritative within declared scope
screenshot/render does not replace interaction source or evaluation evidence
analytics dashboard does not replace event/metric definition or causal research
prototype static check does not replace actual interaction/usability readback
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects production/research/accessibility/web/app/data tools; process does not hardcode a software inventory
actual_readback_requirements: actual research/evaluation evidence read back before HCD research/usability claims
actual prototype/build interaction read back at claimed stage

release support matrix readback covers the claimed browser/OS/device/input/assistive-technology envelope
content/localization and privacy/security handoff registers are read back at release scope
instrumentation and experiment/rollout readback preserves metric validity, guardrails and causal claim ceiling

Experiment / Rollout Object when experimental release is used
independent_review_objects: producer self-check cannot replace user evaluation
does_not_require: same artifacts as physical construction domains
same stage count as other domains

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry evidence-backed context, user need, intended outcome and use-related requirement into product decisions without turning personas/features into research findings.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current research/context evidence + product/service authority + requirement sources.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Retain only when need/requirement trace is explicit; design assumptions remain marked and cannot close research authority.
downstream_handoffs: Systems Engineering where formal requirements apply
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent HCD/research review samples consequential need claims and evidence quality.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Study / Consent / Data Eligibility / Research Freeze Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control research question, sample/recruitment, consent/data eligibility, study/prototype freeze and finding confidence/limitations.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Approved research plan + participant/data handling authority + exact study/prototype/session evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Findings may only be used within consent/purpose/sample/context limits; changed prototype or method stales affected conclusions.
failure_or_hold_conditions: old finding reused after material redesign
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Distinct research review for material findings; privacy/legal owner controls data authority where required.
does_not_prove: privacy/legal approval beyond stated data handling

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interaction / IA / State Concept Option Set
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Compare materially different conceptual models, IA/navigation, task flows, state/error/recovery and channel/fallback strategies before UI lock.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Matched-fidelity flows/prototypes/content models tied to common user/context/use-requirement baseline.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: option_id + common user/requirement baseline + prototype revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Do not count visual styling variants as interaction concepts; compare task architecture and failure/recovery consequences.
failure_or_hold_conditions: same flow with different UI skin called alternative
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent HCD review challenges selected concept against strongest causal alternative and failure state.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Controlled Prototype / Component / Content / State Specification Package
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry interaction design through editable prototype, flow/state, component, content, responsive and accessibility-behavior sources with exact build identity.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Screenshot/static export cannot replace interactive source; every evaluation finding must bind exact prototype/build and state.
failure_or_hold_conditions: static screenshot used as interactive source
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent HCD review on exact prototype/build where promotion-relevant.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Finding → Fix → Build → Retest / Release Support Matrix
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control whether usability/accessibility/content defects are actually fixed in the intended build and supported release matrix before HCD release retention.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Research/evaluation findings + exact design fix + implementation build + test matrix.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: finding_id + fix source revision + exact build/test-matrix revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Finding closes only after the fix exists in the tested build and retest supports the claimed matrix; one browser/device PASS cannot stand for all.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Distinct research/accessibility reviewer for severe findings or accessibility claims as applicable.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Implemented Product Interaction / Accessibility / Runtime Readback Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Bind actual implemented behavior, states, browser/device/input/assistive technology and offline/error handling to the released build.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Actual current build/runtime + HCD specification + tested platform/device/accessibility evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Implemented HCD PASS applies only to actual tested build/environment/support scope; source-build/static checks cannot replace interaction runtime.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent accessibility/HCD review where claimed support/conformance requires.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Live Outcome / Experiment / Support / Reopen Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry live analytics, research, support, accessibility and experiment evidence into bounded product decisions without treating metrics as causal proof.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Governed metric/event definitions + live product/build context + support/research/experiment evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Live decision retains metric validity and causal limits; rollout/experiment result never silently becomes universal user outcome.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent research/data review for consequential causal/rollout claims.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Independent HCD / Research / Accessibility Review Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Independently challenge research evidence, task evaluation, accessibility and implementation readback on exact study/prototype/build identities.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled research/evaluation/build sources + declared support/accessibility claim.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Review applies only to exact research/design/build/support scope; material redesign/rebuild or study change stales affected conclusions.
failure_or_hold_conditions: producer critique presented as user evaluation
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Review independence appropriate to the claim; specialist privacy/security authority remains separate.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: HCD Study / Design / Build / Finding Change Impact Ledger
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Propagate research, need, design, content, accessibility, build and instrumentation changes to affected findings, tests, support matrix and live evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled change event + trace links across HCD research/design/build/live objects.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Change closes only after affected findings/retests/support/live evidence are refreshed or explicitly retained by evidence.
failure_or_hold_conditions: design changed but study remains current
event definition changed without analytics reset
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent re-review when change affects prior material study/accessibility/release conclusion.

assurance.professional_review: HCD professional review at declared stage/claim ceiling, preserving research evidence, context/user requirement trace, interaction rationale and evaluation boundaries.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify research, accessibility, content, privacy/security, implementation and live evidence against the claimed HCD use.
technical_gates: accessibility evaluation gate when conformance/inclusive-use claim is made
engineering/runtime actual-readback gate when implementation/release is claimed
live evidence gate when user outcome/performance is claimed
assurance.independent_review: Distinct HCD professional review for promotion-relevant stage closure, risk/claim proportionate; producer self-check cannot substitute for user research/usability/accessibility evidence.

stale_scope_rules: only affected HCD stages/threads/interfaces/artifacts/reviews become stale unless dependency analysis shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed research/context/authority/requirement evidence reopens all consuming HCD decisions
downstream_impact_rules: changed HCD controlled variables propagate to consuming Engineering/Content/Accessibility/Security-Privacy/Data/Service/System interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable changes reopen affected Cross-Disciplinary Integration interfaces
receipt_stale_rules: HCD receipt becomes stale at affected scope when governing research, evaluated prototype/build, professional review basis or live evidence changes

process_exit_conditions: applicable HCD stage work complete at declared claim ceiling
required native outputs and actual readback exist
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim HCD or specialist items that do not contradict current professional verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Candidate only: no promotion effect. If later promoted Current, a bounded PASS may satisfy only the Digital Product / HCD professional-process dependency and cannot grant Design KEEP, engineering/security/privacy/accessibility/live PASS or Promotion.
